The following events took place in '''200 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The star [[Carosi]] dies, destroying the innermost five planets in the [[Carosus system]].
*[[Yperio Baobab]] creates [[Bab-Prime]], precursor to [[Bab-Neo]] and modern-day [[Binary/Legends|droidspeak]].
*[[Memory wipe/Legends|Memory wipes]] become common [[Droid/Legends|droid]] maintenance following a personality virus unleashed by a member of the [[Baobab Merchant Fleet]].
*The [[Tiercam Dam]] is built on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]].
*[[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]] is discovered by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] scouts of the [[Clan Askar]].
*The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] noticed that [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] had begun to "flux", and feared that the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] was growing again.<ref name="NEC31">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref><ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'', Chapter 22</ref>
*The [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] is founded when [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tarzen Tagge]] uses his fleet of [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] to provide aid to a part of [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] devastated by a series of [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]].<ref name="GoI120" />
*Several [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans defeated the [[Ithullan]]s in a [[Mandalorian–Ithullan war|war]] over a [[Mandallian Narcolethe/Legends|narcolethe]] distillery, after which the victors proceeded to nearly [[Speciecide|exterminate]] the Ithullan [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="NEC31" />
*[[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]] is colonized by [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanians]] around this time.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>

==Births==
*[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]<ref name="Ultimate Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref>
